title: F1 Data Scientist
description:
The Data Intelligence Team works alongside different technical groups to lead the data transformation of the department. Our work focuses on designing, building and deploying end to end data solutions that will enable more effective real-time decisions trackside and allow data-driven design of future sporting and technical regulations.
We seek result-driven, proactive people, who are passionate about building high-quality software solutions that address problems by transforming how engineers use data and technology. They must have a desire to innovate in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, as part of a growing team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in the unique and inspiring world of Motorsport.
The position will be based in our headquarters in Geneva and will involve some travel to Formula 1 championship events.

MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
As F1 Data Scientist your mission is to design, test and deploy data solutions that transform raw motorsport data into powerful, actionable insights. You will work with large and diverse sources of data including telemetry time series, images or regulatory documents across multiple championships with the aim to build innovative tools and models that enhance understanding, and support fast decision-making.
To accomplish this, you will be part of the end-to-end product life-cycle: from requirement gathering and PoC development to deployment of production-ready solutions designed to scale, be understood by end users, meet organisation requirements and adapt as needs evolve.  

This role is ideal for someone who takes initiative, owns their work end-to-end, and actively contributes to a high-performing team.

Data Science
Develop Machine Learning models and advanced analytical tools that can provide further insights for decision-making.  
Further develop the FIA data analytics tool suite to optimise our remote and on-track support operations through real time analysis.
Investigate multimodal approaches that integrate telemetry time series, image, video, audio, and regulatory documents to enrich analytical capabilities.

MLOps Solutions
Build and maintain robust MLOps solutions to ensure scalability, reliability and continuous improvement of the deployed solutions.  
Collaborate with the Data Intelligence group to standardize data processing and promote shared tools across different FIA championships.

Latest Technology Watch
Stay up to date with state-of-the-art models, especially on time series treatment and the multi-modality area.  
Stay up to date on MLOps tools, techniques and best practices to enhance team capabilities.

PROFILE:
Master’s degree or equivalent working experience level in Computer Science, Data Science, AI Engineer, ML Ops Engineer or similar discipline.
You have extensive experience developing clean and efficient software in Python.  
You have significant experience with data wrangling libraries such as pandas, numpy, and PySpark.
You have significant experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as Sklearn, SciPy, XGBoost or Pytorch.
You have extensive experience with the ML development lifecycle and MLOps solutions (MLFlow or similar) for model versioning, registry and experiment tracking.
You have knowledge of CI/CD pipeline implementation and containerization (Docker).  
You have experience with SQL and No-SQL databases.
You have demonstrated an ability to learn continuously and work autonomously. You are comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and fast iteration with users.
You have demonstrated your ability to work effectively within teams with mixed technical expertise.
You are native or fluent in English. French is not required but appreciated.  
You are interested in Motorsport and are curious about how the field evolves and how data can impact it.

title: Terms of Reference Investment Specialist
description:
Terms of Reference
Investment Specialist (80% or full-time)

Catalytic’s mission is to accelerate the design and deployment of catalytic finance solutions for sustainable infrastructure and nature. We identify and develop robust project pipelines and deploy technical assistance to support projects to become more investible and impactful. Catalytic seeks to ensure positive social and environmental outcomes in addition to financial returns for impact investors, applying credible methodologies for the measurement and evaluation of impacts. In addition, Catalytic incubates and structures blended-finance funds aiming at scaling up and speeding up the implementation of infrastructure projects with positive climate impacts.

Catalytic is seeking an Investment Specialist.
Catalytic has also been mandated through Canopy Trust by multiple donors to support and scale up private sector, development-focused investments to reduce deforestation in Central Africa, covering DRC, Republic of the Congo, Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Gabon. To this end, Canopy Trust identifies and builds a robust pipeline of investment funds and local, private sector projects and companies which will lead to  economic development, reduction of deforestation, and conservation of forest in the region. Canopy Trust offers technical assistance and invests catalytic, concessional capital to direct investment, it also investor de-risking junior capital into suitable investment funds that commit to capital allocation to Canopy Trust’s target countries.. The Investment Specialist will primarily work on the investment activities for Canopy Trust.

Reporting to the Deputy CEO and working closely with other team members and Catalytic’s partners, the Investment Specialist will support Catalytic in deploying its concessional capital. This will include originating investment opportunities, conducting evaluation, assessment and due diligence of investment opportunities (investment funds, corporates/SMEs and projects), as well as the negotiation of term sheets, preparation of documentations for the Investment Committees, and finalisation of investment documentations until financial close. The Investment Specialist will also be responsible for managing Canopy Trust’s portfolio of investments, including advising, supporting, and monitoring the investees in the portfolio as well as reporting.

Role & Responsibilities:
Independently lead identification sourcing and management high-quality transaction pipeline in line with Canopy Trust’s mandate, target sectors and geographies through direct outreach and relevant channels in the target region, manage selection workflow and maintain pipeline tracker
Maintain close proximity and awareness with the Canopy Trust Technical Assistance pipeline to be able to assess which of these TA projects to prioritize for investment pipeline and to anticipate the associated timeline
Independently lead investment processes, including screening of investment opportunities and preparing documentation for internal decision-making and prioritization
Independently lead and coordinate due diligence (financial, operational, legal, integrity and ESG), (credit) risk analysis, term sheet negotiation (structuring features, conditions precedent, covenants, reporting and monitoring requirements)
Lead preparation of high-quality investment memorandums and recommendations for submission to the IC, and investment documentation.
Advise, support, and monitor the investees
Manage Canopy Trust’s investment portfolio including post investment activities and analysis
Provide numbers, results, and deliverables for Communication, Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting.
Support in other investment-related activities of Catalytic when required.

Profile:
Minimum 5 years of experience in investment analysis, due diligence, negotiation of term sheets and contracts, structuring and closing transactions, overseeing investees, and portfolio management, preferably at an asset manager, investment bank or financial advisor.
Experience in working in an investment role in Africa and/or other frontier and emerging markets and fragile country contexts, preferably in Canopy Trust’s focus markets
Working experience in direct private debt investments and structuring; experience in restructuring and workouts preferred.
Experience in Canopy Trust’s focus sectors and a good understanding of business development and financial models of infrastructure projects, experience in deforestation-free value chain investment
Experience working in the space of impact, blended-finance investment for climate targets would be a plus.
Experience in managing or investing in and/or managing investment funds, including understanding of blended finance structures and risk mitigation instruments, concessionality and GP diligence would be a plus.
Experience with international standards, such as IFC Performance Standards, Gold Standard, would be a plus.
Passionate about reducing deforestation and climate mitigation with a strong commitment towards a more sustainable world.
Team player, flexible and experienced in working in a multicultural environment.
Taking initiatives and thinking out of the box to find solutions to challenges are needed on a daily basis.
Proficient English and French level in writing and speaking, additional language skills a plus.
Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in business, finance or economics.

The working station will be Geneva, Switzerland, or Kinshasa, DRC, with travels depending on project needs.

The position is possible to start at 80%. However, as the investment portfolio enlarges, it is expected that 100% would be needed at some point in the future.

Please send your CV and a Cover Letter to secretariat@catalyticfinance.org by 31 October 2026. Please indicate clearly on your Cover Letter your intended working station (Geneva or Kinshasa), your intended percentage of working time (80% or 100%), your current place of residence, and whether you have the legal right to work in your intended work station.

title: Junior Chief of Staff (a) (80-100%)
description:
**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.**

Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.**

**Deine Herausforderung**

Du stehst kurz vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  
In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine Rolle im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.

* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**

    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter
    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen
* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**
    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen
    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick
    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen
* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**
    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit
    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten
* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**
    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran
    + Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen und prüfst, wie neue Tools und AI\-Anwendungen bei C\&P sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können
    + Du unterstützt die Co\-CEOs bei konzeptionellen und strategischen Projekten und bringst diese in die Umsetzung


**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder BWL (Uni/FH) abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor
* Du besitzt relevante Praxiserfahrung, die du während oder nach deinem Studium \- via Praktika, Teilzeittätigkeit oder im Rahmen einer Festanstellung \- sammeln durftest
* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität für Technologie, Digitalisierung und AI und freust dich daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren. Dabei denkst du realistisch und weisst, dass wir keine Luftschlösser bauen und dass der konkrete Nutzen gegeben sein muss
* Du wendest die Microsoft 365 Tools gut und gerne an \- insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel
* Du magst Zahlen, bist zuverlässig und gehst die Dinge strukturiert an
* Du bist ein Organisationstalent oder willst und kannst eines werden. So oder so hast du eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
* Du willst, dass deine Marketingaktivitäten Wirkung im Ziel haben. Das Look \& Feel ist dir dabei aber nicht egal.
* Du bist keine Diva und dir nicht zu schade, dir auch mal die Finger schmutzig zu machen und in einem KMU Aufgaben zu erledigen, die eigentlich nicht in deinem Stellenbeschrieb stehen
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
* Du bist so humorvoll, dass du zuweilen auch mal über dich selber lachen kannst


**Wir suchen kein fertiges Profil. Wir suchen jemanden am Anfang seiner oder ihrer Karriere, dem wir zutrauen, sehr schnell zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit j4id10404290a j4it0939a j4iy26a**

title: Strategic Pricing Analyst
description:
About Surgery

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of surgery? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Surgery team will give you the chance to deliver surgical technologies and solutions to surgeons and healthcare professionals around the world. Your contributions will help effectively treat some of the world’s most prevalent conditions such as obesity, cardiovascular disease and cancer. Patients are waiting.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

Strategic Pricing Analyst Surgery - Johnson & Johnson
Are you passionate about making a tangible difference in healthcare?
We are seeking a Strategic Pricing Analyst to join our commercial team.
This role anchors Johnson & Johnson’s go-to-market strategy, emphasizing long-term partnerships, market trends and customer needs.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to advance pricing strategies and new business models, evaluate pricing proposals, and provide guidance on organizational standards related to product performance.
If you’re a strategic thinker with a proven track record in price and margin calculations, you are the candidate we want to hear from.

Roles & responsibilities:
Strategic Pricing is an essential part of the future business strategy for the Johnson & Johnson companies. It influences how we will go to market as a Surgery organization and will be critical to our future growth plans. This approach aligns customer expectations with business objectives with the aim to demonstrate the long-term value of partnership and working with Johnson & Johnson, most importantly, our impact on patient care.
- In the role as Strategic Pricing Analyst you will report to the Commercial Lead of the Swiss Surgery organization and closely collaborate with the Strategic Account Management, the Operational Pricing, the Sales Organization and the Marketing Team.
- Together with the Strategic Account Management and our clinical team, you will coordinate and support the proposal development process, presenting opportunities and risks along with their implications to the required levels of management.
- You will develop data driven pricing-strategies to maximize profitability and competitiveness
- In close collaboration with our Marketing Team you prepare new product launches, go to market models and potential portolio segmentations.
- In conjunction with the Surgery Leadership Team, you will coordinate regular reviews of departmental pricing analysis reports and submit results on a timely basis to the Management for review and subsequents directives.
- Together with the Operational Pricing Team you will analyse current pricing models and structures to identify areas to improve pricing efficiencies for the customer base.

You will define local price-volume guidance and lead the design and testing of new tools to support the local sales force.
To support business plan development and account stretegies you will provide recommendations on alternate pricing models to the Management in order to secure key customer business.

- You will assess and track pricing key performance measures as well as ad hoc analysis and reporting to measure against pricing goals and targets.
- You are the direct link to the EMEA Pricing Team
- Working at Johnson & Johnson implifies understanding and applying of Johnson & Johnson’s Credo and Leadership Imperatives in day-to-day interactions with the team.

Qualifications:
- Academic or financial background, ideally supported by a Master’s degree in Business Administration with several years of experience in pricing or a comparable role.
- Strong understanding of profit and loss statements (P&L), margin analysis, cost structures, and price-demand relationships.
- Experience in contracting and deal structuring is a plus.
- Analytical and strategic thinker with solid business acumen.
- Project management capabilities with the ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
- Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset.
- Excellent written and verbal communication in German, strong English skills (written and spoken) are required; proficiency in a second official language is preferred.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, along with experience using Power BI and other financial analysis tools; programming skills are an asset, ERP (S4/H) knowledge is a plus.

title: IBU Access & Value Lead - Orexin Franchise
description:
About the Role:
- Brands in-scope: Oveporexton
- Be an active member of the Takeda’s access community and value chain that ensure patients have access to innovative treatments ensuring timely, sustainable reimbursement and uptake through robust payer value propositions, evidence generation, HTA readiness, and effective cross-functional delivery.
- Work very closely with Global Access Strategy team to ensure execution within IBU.
- Lead and own IBU access strategy, provide strategic inputs for 6 core markets, and execute market access readiness across international markets for Oveporexton. Ensure integrating disease‑area insights, payer expectations, competitive intelligence, and evidence‑generation requirements to inform IBU decisions and maximize patient access in international markets.
- Act as a core member of cross‑functional teams, working with global and IBU partners (Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, HEOR, Global Access & Pricing, Pipeline, etc.) to embed access considerations into key strategic decisions.
- Be part of Global Pricing and Access (GPA) function, contributing to advance GPA governance and ways of working, to influencing functional excellence (Access, Pricing, cross‑TA collaboration, capability building) and to shaping the access vision and capability roadmap.

How you will contribute:
IBU - Oveporexton Access Business Partner
- Plan and execute initiatives across IBU markets to ensure the global access and pricing strategy’s success of Oveporexton in a competitive, highly regulated environment.
- Serve as primary point of contact for IBU Local Access teams for Oveporexton; drive access and pricing strategy execution to enable timely patient access, including P&R success through strong HTA readiness and payer negotiation preparedness, as well as sustained value maximization across life cycle management.
- Partner with LOCs to set the right ambition for LOCs and guide the LOCs with the scenario planning and access plan development to maximize access opportunities. Provide hands-on guidance for priority markets and high-stakes negotiations.
- Support LOCs directly for their value proposition development, negotiation preparation, competitive response, and complex payer interactions.
- Support contracting / access levers where relevant (e.g., VBC, Entry agreements, business cases development, patient support approaches), aligned to compliance requirements and corporate governance.
- Ensure reporting and transparency of access strategy execution and pricing actions, reimbursement status, payer risks, and readiness KPIs for senior leadership.
- Develop an updated IBU access strategy by systematically integrating key insights from leading international congresses and external payer forums within the relevant therapeutic area.
- Proactively foster a growth mindset across and beyond P&R/HTA requirements by encouraging Takeda’s access community to engage with the broader external healthcare ecosystem, including patient voice and services, medical partners to leverage further real-world evidence (RWE) and data generation initiatives, publication planning, to adopt digitalization opportunities, and to systematically apprehend evolving legislative developments.
- Manage and coordinate budget for assigned assets.

GPA / Global Collaboration
- Work closely with Global Pricing & Access Strategy teams to support Pricing & Access optimization by developing analysis, contributing to pricing research, and ensuring P&R guidance is implemented consistently across the IBU.
- Anticipate LOE, biosimilar/generic impact, expansion of indication, external pressure, and competitive responses unique to the TA working closely with the LOE offices.
- Act as a core member of cross‑functional teams, working with global and IBU partners (Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, HEOR, Global Access & Pricing, Pipeline, etc.) to embed access considerations into key strategic decisions.
- Connect local, IBU, and global teams to strengthen the value proposition through fit‑for‑purpose deliverables (e.g., value dossiers, health economic evidence, objection handler, negotiation playbook, training) that improve value perception and ensure consistent, high‑quality execution across markets.
- Collaborate with medical and evidence generation / HEOR teams to identify evidence gaps and integrate timely access needs within the evidence strategy, ensuring new clinical data and RWE strengthens payer value narratives (contributing to business cases to support prioritization of evidence generation as needed).

Future Readiness / capability
- Monitor and interpret market access trends, reimbursement policy changes, and coverage decisions; identify payer evidence gaps; and translate insights into actions on emerging opportunities and risks, in partnership with GPA access strategy and pipeline teams.
- Lead a multi‑layer TA Access function across the IBU to ensure cross‑market consistency, execution excellence, share practices and accelerated access outcomes; define TA‑specific capabilities and implement the agreed operating model in partnership with Global Access, Global Pricing, IBU Medical, MCE, and IBU Regulatory.
- Equip, guide and train local teams/partners with processes, standards, tools, and decision frameworks to build high-quality LOCs access excellence in execution.
-Lead and be a role model to digital capability adoption throughout the access community
- Develop and run mock negotiations within the specific TA and orchestrate capability training, and simulation exercises for markets.
- Foster collaboration and best practice sharing across GPA teams, access and cross-functions and geographies partners.
- Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives sponsored by the GPA function or Takeda, broadening organizational impact, strengthening cross-functional alignment, and driving enterprise value (mAI access – CXF – JHTA – VBHC ...)

Skills:
- Solid experience in Local and preferably Regional Market Access & Pricing, with demonstrated leadership across TA areas and complex payer environments.
- Proven ability to shape TA‑level access strategy across the full asset lifecycle (launch, inline, LOE), including advisory to senior governance bodies.
- Deep knowledge of global payer systems, reimbursement pathways and pricing dynamics, particularly across Europe and Intercontinental markets.
- Strong portfolio readiness expertise, including payer scenario planning, pricing insights & trends, evidence requirements, and competitive access risk management.
- Advanced capability to integrate clinical, HEOR, RWE and competitive insights into clear payer value propositions and access decision‑making.
- Demonstrated matrix leadership, working effectively with Global Access, Pricing, Medical, Regulatory and Commercial partners and being at ease to navigate a complex matrix of multi stakeholders.
- Project/program management and prioritization capability across parallel workstreams and deadlines.
- People and capability cross-functional influencing experience, including leading multi‑layer, geographically dispersed Access teams and driving functional capability development.
- Learning agility to adapt to new assets within the assigned TA, portfolio or any new situation, continuing to lead within changes and uncertainties and deliver results.
- Strategic thinking: Ability to think strategically and make sound, forward-looking decisions, based on strong business acumen to identify challenges and opportunities and drive impact.
- Communication: Ability to communicate effectively and influence diverse global and Local stakeholders with strong interpersonal and influencing skills in a multicultural, international environment and proven ability to build alignment.
- Resilience with ambiguity and cross-cultural collaboration across international markets/partners.
- Digital and AI-forward: Experience leveraging digital platforms, data analytics, and AI-driven tools to enhance decision-making and access strategy execution is a plus

========================================

**About Korean Re Switzerland AG**  

Korean Re Switzerland AG (rated 'A\+' with a stable outlook by S\&P) is a 100% subsidiary of  
Korean Re in Seoul, an international reinsurance group with more than USD 5\.7 bn of gross  
written premium and a track\-record of more than 60 years in the reinsurance industry.  
Korean Re Switzerland's mission is to build on Korean Re's long\-standing experience in Europe  
and to expand Korean Re's footprint in the Continental European reinsurance markets. We are  
committed to providing reinsurance services of high standards to deliver value for our clients,  
shareholders and employees. For more information about our team and company, please visit  
.  
Korean Re Switzerland offers a vibrant and fast\-moving environment with a capable and highly  
motivated team. We live an empowered corporate culture with a strong cross\-functional team  
spirit.

As part of a two\-person IT team, you will play a key role in shaping and advancing KRSA's  
technology, data, and reporting landscape. You will combine the responsibilities of application

position with direct exposure to senior management.

effectively support the company's strategic objectives and future growth

company. For someone who enjoys combining business understanding with technology and  
data expertise, this position provides broad responsibility, considerable autonomy, and the  
opportunity to shape the future of our IT environment.

• Product owner for Synergy2, KRSA's core reinsurance administration platform, manage  
backlogs, testing and ongoing improvements  
• Act as the primary liaison between business users and external vendors translating business  
requirements into practical technology solutions  
• Design and deliver business solutions, defining requirements, scope, priorities, and UAT while  
identifying opportunities for process optimization and automation  
• Lead and coordinate IT projects from requirements through implementation and postdeployment  
support  
*Business Analytics, Reporting \& Automation*  
• Design and maintain data flows and integrations between Synergy2 and reporting, finance,  
underwriting, claims and pricing systems  
• Ensure data quality, integrity and consistency across applications and databases  
• Support quarterly and annual financial closing processes through data extraction,  
reconciliation, and reporting  
• Develop and maintain reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI, SAP Business Objects,  
MS SQL  
• Deliver management information and reporting solutions for underwriting, portfolio  
monitoring, claims, receivables, cash allocation, and pricing  
Contribute to IT Governance, Infrastructure, and Vendor Management  
• Manage the IT budget and support cost control activities in collaboration with Finance.  
• Occasional coordination of IT audits and related follow\-up tasks in collaboration with Risk  
Management/Compliance  
Skills \& experience  
*Education \& Languages*  
• University degree (MSc or BSc) in Information Systems, Business Information Systems,  
Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field  
• Fluent English is required  
• Korean and/or additional European languages are considered an advantage  
Professional Experience  
• Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in IT application management, business  
intelligence, data management, technology, preferably within the (re\-)insurance or financial  
services sector.  
• Experience managing third\-party software vendors and technology service providers.  
• Experience in designing and supporting business\-critical applications and data environments.  
• understanding of insurance or reinsurance business processes, including underwriting,  
operations, finance, reinsurance accounting and reporting  
*Technical Skills*  
• Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases, preferably MS SQL  
• Experience with Power BI, Business Objects and Excel\-based reporting solution  
• Familiarity with automation technologies and API\-based integrations is an advantage  
• understanding of application and data architecture, system integration, cloud concepts,  
and modern IT infrastructure environments

similar tools  
***Personal Attributes***  
• Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving capabilities  
• Ability to translate business requirements into practical and sustainable technology solutions

mentor across functions

Inbetriebnahmeleiter (m/w/d) in Baden

IndustrieAlpine – Wir bringen Menschen und Unternehmen in Einklang!

In den Bereichen der Gebäudetechnik und dem Anlagenbau sind wir ein führender Service Provider für Facility Management und Industrial Services. Wir arbeiten mit den führenden europäischen Partnerunternehmen eng zusammen, wodurch unsere unbefristeten Arbeitsverhältnisse auf eine lange Zusammenarbeit ausgerichtet sind. Eine Übernahmemöglichkeit besteht immer.

Weiterhin bieten wir unseren Arbeitnehmern (m/w/d) ein partnerschaftliches Konzept für persönliche Entwicklung und berufliches Wachstum.

Unser täglicher Antrieb ist eine langfristige und zufriedene Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und Mitarbeitern (m/w/d).

Als Teammitglied der IndustrieAlpine-Gruppe genießt Du alle Vorteile eines erfolgreichen, international agierenden Unternehmens - einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag, eine übertarifliche Bezahlung, eine gute Work Life Balance sowie kontinuierliche Weiterbildungsangebote.

Im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung suchen wir für einen Projekteinsatz bei unserem Kunden in Baden einen Inbetriebnahmeleiter (m/w/d).

Ihr zukünftiges Aufgabengebiet

- Gesamtverantwortliche Planung, Steuerung und Koordination der Pre-Commissioning- und Commissioning-Aktivitäten im zugewiesenen Verantwortungsbereich
- Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Inbetriebnahmestrategie einschließlich Ablaufplanung, Terminplan und Kostenkontrolle
- Führung, Koordination und fachliche Unterstützung des eingesetzten Commissioning-Teams
- Erstellung und laufende Aktualisierung des Commissioning-Terminplans sowie der zugehörigen Personal- und Ressourcenplanung
- Sicherstellung der termingerechten Erreichung der Projektmeilensteine unter Einhaltung des vorgesehenen Budgets
- Erstellung von Ausführungs- und Inbetriebnahmeplänen in Abstimmung mit Site Manager, Projektmanagement und Kunden
- Durchführung von Projekt-Risikobewertungen sowie Nachverfolgung der daraus resultierenden Maßnahmen zur Risikominimierung


Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium, beispielsweise Maschinenbau, Energietechnik, Verfahrenstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
- Mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme von Gas- und GuD-Kraftwerken (CCPP)
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse des mechanischen Balance of Plant (BOP) und der dazugehörigen Kraftwerksnebenanlagen
- Fundierte Kenntnisse des Wasser-Dampf-Kreislaufs (Water-Steam Cycle) eines GuD-Kraftwerks
- Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung eines Commissioning-Teams bei Pre-Commissioning- und Commissioning-Aktivitäten
- Erfahrung mit Systemübergaben von Construction an Commissioning sowie von Commissioning an den Kunden
- Erfahrung in Terminplanung, Ressourcenplanung, Kostenkontrolle und Projekt-Risikomanagement
- Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift, Französisch auf C2-Niveau
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Vorgehensweise bei technischen Problemen
- Sehr gute Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, internationale Teams zu koordinieren und zu motivieren
- Durchsetzungsvermögen und überzeugendes Auftreten gegenüber Kunden, Projektpartnern und internen Schnittstellen

Hä? Passt doch gar nicht!

Sie möchten eigentlich gerne etwas anderes tun, aber auch Ihre Berufserfahrung nutzen?
Gerne prüfen wir weitere Möglichkeiten einer Zusammenarbeit und stellen Ihnen passende Vakanzen vor.

Das ist uns sehr wichtig

Wir haben einen sehr hohen Anspruch an unseren Kundenservice.
Offenheit, Freundlichkeit und Geduld sollten daher zu Ihren Grundeigenschaften gehören. Der Umgang mit den unterschiedlichsten Menschen bereitet Ihnen Freude.

Wir bieten Ihnen

- Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag.
- 5 Tage Vollzeit (48 Stunden).
- Professionelle Betreuung bis zum Projektbeginn und darüber hinaus.
- Wir sind im Umgang miteinander offen, ehrlich, direkt, freundlich und unkompliziert.
- Sie erwarten die nettesten Kunden.
- Wertschätzung und eine Arbeitsatmosphäre, die für gute Energie sorgt.

So geht es weiter

Bewerben Sie sich bitte direkt online, indem Sie auf den Jetzt-auf-diese Stelle-bewerben-Button klicken oder senden Sie uns eine WhatsApp an die angegebene Rufnummer.
Nutzen Sie bei Fragen vorab die Kontaktdaten Ihres Ansprechpartners.
Wir vereinbaren einen Telefontermin für ein kurzes Interview. Anschließend lernen wir uns persönlich kennen und besprechen alle Einzelheiten.

Sie möchten wechseln? Das bleibt unter uns!

Falls Sie sich in einem ungekündigten Arbeitsverhältnis befinden, sichern wir Ihnen natürlich höchste Vertraulichkeit Ihrer Bewerbung zu.

- Telefoninterviews und Vorstellungsgespräche gerne auch nach Feierabend oder am Wochenende.

Onboarding & Flughöhe

Als neues Mitglied im Team möchten Sie natürlich schnell auf Flughöhe kommen. Dazu werden Sie direkt vor Ort durch die Kolleginnen und Kollegen eingearbeitet.

Klingt das gut? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt. Klicken Sie direkt unten auf den Button.

Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Have we piqued your interest?

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

title: International Payroll Administrator 100%

title: University Admissions Counsellor
description:
Role Description La Garenne International School would like to appoint a University Admissions Counsellor to help guide our students through their learning journey and work closely with colleagues and parents to ensure that a personalised pathway is clearly defi ned for each student.
The role incorporates a wide range of responsibilities, including but not limited to: Leadership &

Collaboration
● The implementation and oversight of the Higher Education & Futures (HEF) programme, ensuring that we fulfi ll the 8 Gatsby Benchmarks
● Work closely with the school’s HEF Coordinator to ensure a collaborative and systematic approach to preparing our Secondary School students for university admission.
● Working closely with other HEF providers to facilitate a comprehensive and personalised approach to HEF support for Secondary School students
● The maintenance of personalised HEF pathways for individual students across the Secondary School
● Liaising with colleagues across schools departments (e.g. Subject Coordinators, Learning Support, Boarding, School Counsellor) to ensure that you have the whole picture of each student, aiding pathway personalisation and tailoring both Teacher and Counsellor references
● Regular, proactive consultation with students and parents to establish and refi ne HEF pathways
● Taking responsibility for country-specifi c application processes
● Leading in-house student and staff workshops

Organisation & Administration
● Supporting the HEF Coordinator in the creation and maintenance of a HEF Calendar which includes all key dates pertaining to careers, university guidance, supra-curricular / personal development opportunities
● Support in managing and updating HEF development, tracking and application systems, including (but not limited to) Unifrog, CommonApp and UCAS, ensuring that student data is kept up to date and the development of each student’s progress is closely monitored with appropriate interventions in place
● Support in coordinating and overseeing the application process in its entirety with distinct groups of students; reference-writing and collation, sourcing and uploading student transcripts, supporting all written application material (e.g. UCAS personal statement, Common App essays, US College supplementary essays, Letters of Intention etc.), uploading references and both sourcing and providing quality assurance throughout this process, ahead of fi nal submission
● Support in managing and facilitating access and support with SAT, IELTS and other HEF pathway assessments/admission tests and interview preparation, as required, including registration, portal administration and oversight of logistics, including access arrangements
● Support in arranging local and international university visits depending upon the interests of the students, in addition to ensuring our attendance at local university fairs and other events which could help to strengthen university applications
● Support in coordinating programmes of seminars, webinars and subject-specifi c workshops/ one-to-ones related to the HEF programme
● Working with the Marketing Team to promote and celebrate the HEF programme at La Garenne
● Support with the organisation of an annual ‘Futures Week’ for the Secondary School students
● Communicate regularly with families to provide application and progress updates General duties
● Ensuring your availability (on campus / remotely, as required) following the release of external examination results, supporting the analysis and evaluation of HEF pathways, liaising with colleagues, students and families as required
● Pursuing appropriate professional development, including attendance at annual conference(s) related to HEF pathways and provision
● Teaching responsibilities related to your subject area, as required by school and in consideration of the demands of the role (note that a non-teaching role may be more appropriate / preferred)
● Demonstrating a professional, friendly and respectful attitude towards all members of the La Garenne community at all times
● Assisting with other duties as assigned by the Head of Section, School Principal or General Director, in response to school needs

Expectations of all teachers
All teachers are required to carry out rota duties to ensure that students can be safely supervised across both campuses at all times and to ensure better communication beyond the classroom. As part of their commitment to school life, teaching staff members are expected to attend all events (see list below) and should be prepared to accompany children on other day or residential trips within Switzerland or beyond if required.

● Parent/Teacher Days (during the school day)
● Student parties (Halloween, Christmas & End of Year Celebration)
● Staff Christmas Party
● Supporting weekend study sessions if required (Saturday morning)
● Overnight Group Expedition (All full time Teachers should accompany once a year; 1 night 2 days) ● Boarding duties on a rota basis (if required)
● Ski Race (during the school day) and Medal Presentation Ceremony
● Charity Days (during the school day)
● School Challenge Days (usually on Sunday afternoons)
● Sports Day (during the school day)
● School Show & End of Year Ceremony (during the school day)

The Ideal Candidate
You will be an educator who is dedicated to continual improvement and embodies the attributes of the IB Learner Profi le.

● Has a good honours degree and/or a further degree
● Embraces a commitment to working within the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion
● Is passionate about their specialist teaching subject and can enthuse others
● Embraces developments and innovations in teaching and learning and is willing to experiment with new practices
● Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
● Shares the educational vision of La Garenne International School including our holistic vision of education and is excited to contribute to the co-curricular and pastoral aspects of life at the school
● Has strong interpersonal skills and can build relationships and collaborate with colleagues and the school leadership
● Has experience in dealing with university admissions
● Experience working in a boarding school setting
● A proven track record of taking initiative
● An understanding of university admissions procedures or a strong willingness to learn
● Familiarity with the IB Diploma Programme and ideally the US High School Diploma
● Possesses a positive outlook, an optimistic approach to change and development, and a good sense of humour

Benefi ts We are committed to ensuring that all of our teaching staff continue to develop themselves professionally and embrace new and innovative approaches to teaching and learning. The successful candidate will teach in our new Senior school campus, which has contemporary, bright teaching spaces equipped with the latest educational technology. The school has a range of additional benefi ts including:
● The opportunity to live and work in a beautiful area with great connections to the rest of Europe
● A safe and secure environment in which to work
● Numerous outdoor activities (particularly as Villars is a renowned ski resort)
● An opportunity to learn or improve your French
● To work in a school with an excellent reputation
● To be part of a growing school with opportunities for advancement
● Attractive working conditions
● Professional development opportunities
● Possibility to travel internationally
● Depending on availability, free tuition for staff children
● To teach in modern classrooms with the latest technology
● Approximately 15 weeks of annual holiday spread throughout the year
● Annual ski pass off ered by the school for full-time teaching staff
● Final interviews held at the school at our expense once approved by the General Director

How to apply We welcome any applicant who has a passion for education, who is ready to give each learner individual attention, participate in the life of the whole school and will uphold our guiding principles.

If this is you, please apply online via TES/Schrole or, alternatively, send:
● A complete Curriculum Vitae
● A letter of application
● A copy of your passport information page and/or Swiss work permit (if applicable)
To our Human Resources department (hr@la-garenne.ch) Chemin des Chavasses 23, 1885 Chesières Switzerland

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator - 3 months
description:

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Talent Acquisition Coordinator to support the end\-to\-end recruitment process and contribute to the continuous improvement of talent acquisition activities. This role combines candidate management, recruitment operations and administrative coordination to ensure an exceptional hiring experience for both candidates and stakeholders.





Talent Acquisition Coordinator \- 3 months

Recruitment Coordination \& Candidate Management

title: Critical Infrastructure Mechanical Engineer, Field Engineering
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Field Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:
* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.
* Possess excellent communication and writing skills, attention to detail, maintain high quality standards.
* Organized and have the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines and budget
* Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.
* Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).
* Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.
* Excited about a mix of office and field work.

**Key job responsibilities
**

You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:

* Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers in your region.
* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
* Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
* Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.
* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.
* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

**About the team
**

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.


**Diverse Experiences
**

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.


**Work/Life Balance
**

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


**Inclusive Team Culture
**

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.


**Mentorship and Career Growth
**

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications
* Business-level fluency in written and spoken English
* Willing to travel between Data Center sites, and internationally if required
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering or equivalent
* Experience with mission critical facilities engineering including but not limited to the following sectors: data centers, power generation, oil & gas facilities. (Experienced Engineer).
Preferred qualifications
* Possess data analytics skills, data querying skills/language, scripting, and comfort with working in vast amounts of data in new and evolving environments
* Direct experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers.
* Experience as resident engineer or hands-on (in the field) design consultant or owner’s engineer.
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region. Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents.
* Ability to carry design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment/mass production.
* Basic understanding of both mechanical and/or electrical equipment/design related to data centers (Including but not limited to: uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switch gear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, fans, air economizers, water treatment, etc...).
* EPMS/SCADA/BMS Controls system experience (software and/or hardware)
* Business-level fluency in written and spoken German and English
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

Gas Turbine Plant Operator
==========================

**Your primary responsibility is to monitor and control the gas turbine power plant systems from the control room, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation. You will identify and respond to operational disturbances, initiate corrective actions, and coordinate with the relevant stakeholders to maintain plant availability and performance.**


**Your tasks**

* Monitor and operate power plant equipment and systems using the Emerson Ovation control system;
* Perform plant start\-up, shutdown, and load adjustment procedures;
* Identify, analyze, and respond to alarms, faults, and operational disturbances;
* Perform and document switching operations in accordance with safety procedures;
* Support emergency response activities during abnormal operating conditions;
* Coordinate activities with Maintenance, Engineering, and external service providers;
* Maintain shift logs, operational records, and incident reports;
* Conduct plant inspections and verify equipment conditions in the field;
* Support maintenance activities, outages, overhauls, and recommissioning;
* Ensure effective shift handovers and compliance with plant procedures and safety regulations.




**Your profile**

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification;
* Strong technical understanding of power generation or industrial process systems;
* Several years of experience in the operation of power plants, industrial plants, or process facilities is preferred, experience in the power generation industry is considered a strong advantage;
* Minimum one year of experience in commissioning activities;
* Ability to remain calm and take decisions under pressure;
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills;
* Critical thinking, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities;
* Well\-organized with the ability to plan, prioritize, and coordinate activities efficiently;
* Open\-minded team player with a proactive attitude;
* Willingness to travel internationally for up to 30% of working time;
* Excellent command of English; German is considered an advantage.




**Your benefit with us**

* A collaborative and highly motivated international team environment;
* Contribute to a reliable and sustainable energy infrastructure;
* Interesting and challenging tasks with a high level of responsibility;
* Exposure to advanced gas turbine and power generation technologies;
* Opportunities for professional growth and development;
* Enjoy a modern workplace in Birr (AG), Switzerland, conveniently located between Zurich and Basel**.**
